label: post-publication addendum, provisional, after the Stage 9 hierarchy, never gated
scoring_rule: lens.stage9.mirofish.score/1: scored tests are those that ran (final done or failed). MiroFish hit = 1 when its pick is a best arm (Stage 9 is_best), else 0; cannot tell, invalid and failed score 0, and so does a pick of an arm the outcome read dropped (counted). Lens and the frontier arms: Stage 9 best-of-k hits (ties in score split credit). Chance = mean 1/k, k = the arms the outcome read kept. L = (rate - chance) / (1 - chance). 95% percentile cluster bootstrap by test, 2,000 resamples, seed 9000, for each rate, each L and each paired difference (other arm minus MiroFish).
order_note: MiroFish saw one fixed order per test and its pick scores 1 or 0. The F1 arms saw two orders and scored 0.5 per order.
credit_note: A MiroFish test with no valid pick scores 0, and a valid MiroFish pick of an arm the Stage 9 outcome read dropped scores 0 and is counted in n_pick_off_record. In both cases an F1 arm gets chance credit, because best_of_k_hits splits a tie among the kept arms. Chance uses k = the arms the outcome read kept, which can be fewer than the versions MiroFish was shown.
